parameters.note: Lake Schmidell is a deep high-alpine lake/reservoir in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co., ~7,900 ft) on the western (Sacramento / American River) side of the Sierra crest — outside the Lake Tahoe basin — so the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152)) does not apply. It is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1) governs: open all year, 5/10. The lake is not in CDFW's 2026 provisional stocking plan; a self-sustaining brook trout ('Brookies') population is reported by a third-party angling reference (flyfishingthesierra.com).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
